blinding_guess.why: Ros_SimpleMsg_MotionReply fills groupNo/sequence/command/result/subcode for both MOTO_MOTION_CTRL and JOINT_TRAJ_PT_FULL replies (command = ROS_MSG_JOINT_TRAJ_PT_FULL, groupNo/sequence echoed from the trajectory point; history marks this as the 06/12/2013 fix, v.1.0.1), and the reply field order matches the ROS-side MotionReply layout in the same snapshot; the only irregularity seen is that an unrecognised MotoMotionCtrl command leaves the reply unbuilt (no default case), which the ROS side does not send.

notes: The unit is controller-side C code (MotoPlus), not a ROS node: it exchanges ROS-Industrial simple_message frames over TCP (motion server TCP_PORT_MOTION 50240, state server TCP_PORT_STATE 50241, TCP_NODELAY set at Controller.c:247). The interface elements are C structs in fs100/MotoPlus/SimpleMessage.h (SmBodyMotoMotionReply, SmBodyMotoMotionCtrl, SmBodyJointTrajPtFull) identified on the wire by msgType 2002/2001/14; msg_type values use the packet's canonical names for these structs. The code's identifier for the robot_id field of both MotoMotionReply and JointTrajPtFull is groupNo (same first-field position and 'Robot/group ID' meaning as robot_id in the ROS-side layout); declares/references use the canonical names with the local name recorded in provenance. Field types are as written in the C struct (int; result is the enum SmResultType). No .msg/.srv/.action/.idl definition exists for any element in the snapshot and ros_distro is null, so every definition_id is null; for the same reason msg:motoman/MotoMotionReply, although clearly declared (struct SimpleMessage.h:189-197, built and sent by Ros_SimpleMsg_MotionReply SimpleMessage.c:96-133 and MotionServer.c:254), has no declares entry, because the msg template requires a definition_hash.py value that cannot be computed; it is not in not_declared. QoS, rate_hz and min_rate_hz are null (no ROS transport; replies are sent one per received message, no rate set). Frame 'none' for all elements: IDs/codes, and joint-space trajectory data with no frame field. perm_requires records the controller REMOTE-mode check that gates START_TRAJ_MODE and motion readiness (bRobotJobReady); E-stop/hold/not-operating are also rejected but are safety states rather than permissions. manifest_version is fs100/package.xml 1.0.0; the MotoPlus sources' own history says 'Release v.1.0.1' (MotionServer.c:7, SimpleMessage.c:5). Other observations: header comments label MotoMotionCtrl/Reply as 2011/2012 while the enum values are 2001/2002 (SimpleMessage.h:55-56,134,189); MotoPlus accepts ROS_CMD_DISCONNECT = 200130 (SimpleMessage.h:130), which the ROS-side MotionControlCmd enum in the same snapshot does not list; the size-mismatch path in WaitForSimpleMsg replies INVALID with subcode 0 rather than ROS_RESULT_INVALID_MSGSIZE (MotionServer.c:248).
